rationale: The only implementation delta is the length passed to strncpy when copying req->name into hid->name: the vulnerable version uses a literal 128, while the fixed version uses sizeof(req->name) - 1. The Logic section does not describe this name-copy operation, its length, or any bound/termination behavior. Its claims about allocating read data, copying user data, initializing HID properties, blacklist handling, and cleanup are true of both implementations.
